# Designer Bundle Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor. This is not a fixed pack that installs everything at once, and it is not a page that only links to other pages. It is a dynamic orchestrator: a single skill that works for you, in plain words, at the moment you need design help.

How it works, in order: 1. You say what you want to make, in normal words. A site, a page, a presentation, a simple visual. No design jargon needed. 2. It does a quick check of what good design means for your case: colours, layout, typography, readability, and consistency, so the result looks clean and stays easy to read. 3. It searches Skill Harbor for skills that fit that need. 4. By default, it only looks for free skills that need no API key, no account, and no payment. That way it works right away, with no setup. 5. It shows you a short list, three to five skills, with what each one does, what it does not do, and its verification status. It never invents a skill and never hides a requirement. 6. It waits for your go before installing anything. Nothing is installed without the list shown first. 7. It installs only what you approved, uses those skills step by step, colours and layout first, then typography and polish, and then summarizes the result in plain words, with clear next steps.
